profile.description: Digi Communications N.V. provides telecommunication services in Romania, Spain, Portugal, and Belgium, and mobile telephony services in Italy. It offers pay-TV, such as cable and direct-to-home television services, fixed internet and data, mobile telephony and data, and fixed-line telephony services, as well as mobile telecommunication and mobile internet services. The company was formerly known as Cable Communications Systems N.V. and changed its name to Digi Communications N.V. in April 2017. Digi Communications N.V. was founded in 1992 and is based in Bucharest, Romania.
